title: 1991 AMC 8 Problem 18
statement: The vertical axis indicates the number of employees, but the scale was accidentally omitted from this graph. What percent of the employees at the Gauss Company have worked there for \(5\) years or more?

solutions.text:
No matter the missing scale, each X represents the same number of employees. There are \(9\) X’s over years \(5\) through \(10,\) and \(30\) X’s in all.

So the fraction is \(\dfrac{9}{30} = 30\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Since the vertical scale is unknown, work with the number of X’s rather than any value
Divide the X’s over years \(5\) through \(10\) by the total number of X’s
